Army Cooking & Training Hardening: Verified Saved Recipes tab confirmation, clan request modal dismissal, and resilient non-blocking bin clearing.
Deterministic Contour Wall Upgrader: 5.5ms contour HUD reader, HSV pure white digit templates, automatic -1 wall stepback, and 100% gem spending protection.
Error Modal Recovery: 100% automated handling for Disconnect/Inactivity popups and post-attack Star Bonus Okay buttons.
Discord Webhook Notifications: asynchronous rich embed updates for battle attacks, star counts, wall upgrades, and account switching.
Multi-Account 24/7 Continuous Loop: unattended Supercell ID rotation with automatic network drop and error dialog recovery.
Signed Ed25519 Auto-Updates: optional zero-downtime updates strictly preserving config.json and license.json.
